name: LOADED_EXTERNAL_CVG_DATA
description: Clarity table for no-add single items in LCI.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_CVG_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the loaded coverage information record.

columns.name: PAT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the patient record linked to the External ID bundle associated with this external coverage data.

columns.name: EXT_DEMOG_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the External Demographic Set that this external coverage is loaded to.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_CVG_PAYER_ID_PAYOR_NAME
columns.description: The name of the payor.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_CVG_PLAN_ID_BEN_PACKAGE_NAME
columns.description: *** Deprecated *** In table CLARITY_EPP_OT, the column BEN_PACKAGE_NAME (CMK .2) has been deprecated.  This column already exists as BENEFIT_PACKAGE_NM (CMK .2) in table CL_CMK. To look up the deprecated column's value after the Clarity Compass upgrade, join column CLARITY_EPP_OT.BEN_PACKAGE_ID to table CL_CMK column BENEFIT_PACKAGE_ID and get the BENEFIT_PACKAGE_NM value.   The name of the benefit package for this benefit plan.The ID of the benefit package is in the column BEN_PACKAGE_ID.
